generation.prompt_exact:
Edit the FIRST supplied project-generated inland canyon yard reference into a clean San Diego inland canyon yard foundation, seasonal version: WINTER. Produce ONE complete opaque 1536x1024 landscape image. Keep the FIRST image's camera, single-point garden perspective, canyon horizon position near y250, layered distant canyon ridge shapes, rear wood-and-wire fence near y420 and dry decomposed-granite/stone ground plane. The second and third references only show the approved calm open staging and restrained detailed naturalistic pixel-art texture, not replacement geography. Maintain deliberate square pixel clusters/stepped contours, rich controlled material detail and calm lower-contrast ground so small birds will remain focus. No photographic airbrush, no UI, no labels or borders.
CRITICAL CLEAN FOUNDATION EDIT: REMOVE every near/foreground tree trunk, canopy, overhanging branch, side shrub, flower, grass tuft, succulent and plant from inside the yard in the first image, including ALL rear fence-border shrubs/flowers and both bottom corners. Remove local potted plants, pots, furniture and any placeable object. Replace those removed areas with authentic newly generated quiet ground/empty soil. Keep the wooden fence and bare perimeter stone edging; simplify existing border boulders into a low continuous unobtrusive stone/soil margin. Clear the entire foreground and central yard from x0 to1536 and y540 to1024 with NO local foliage or props and no large cast tree shadows. Distant chaparral on the canyon slopes BEYOND the fence is allowed as fixed background scenery. Broad bright open center, tiny restrained sparse gravel flecks only; no patterned high-contrast pebble carpet, no invented streams, paths or water features. No birds, people, wildlife, feeders, baths or new props. The original left tree is absent, so show continuous sky/canyon behind where its canopy stood. This image is an intentionally flattened background, not a layer sheet.
SEASONAL ART DIRECTION: WINTER: cool moist-season light under soft pale-blue/gray broken clouds; distinctly greener distant canyon cover with muted sage and olive recovery, cooler softly damp earth tones on clean gravel yard. No snow, ice, frost, bare temperate deciduous forest or standing puddles. Keep ground open and light enough for dark bird contrast.
Keep canyon composition and fence geometry stable between seasons; use daylight, not sunset/night. All four seasons belong to San Diego coastal-influenced inland Southern California, never temperate snowy winter or blanket orange deciduous fall. Regional seasonal appearance must be visible chiefly in distant chaparral color and sky/ground moisture/light. No near planting even in spring. Full-bleed opaque rectangular canvas.
